meta.comment: Central tuning file. Edit numbers here instead of in JS. Future systems will read from this config.

startingState.comment: Master's parting gift — see DESIGN.md 'Spirit Stone Acquisition' and ROADMAP 'Spirit stones origin endowment'. The only spirit-stone source in Phase 2; sect stipends replace this in Phase 5. Tunable here, with the canonical 50-stone fallback in js/core/game.js.

loop.comment: GameLoop tuning. tickRateMs is the fixed simulation step; uiRefreshRateMs throttles 'loop:uiRefresh' emissions; maxFrameDeltaMs clamps per-frame deltas so tab switches cannot cause huge time jumps.

save.comment: SaveManager tuning. autosaveIntervalMs is how often the game autosaves (0 disables the interval); saveOnUnload persists on beforeunload.

offline.comment: OfflineProgress tuning. maxOfflineMs caps how much away-time is simulated per session (0 disables gains). producers declares every resource that accrues while away: path = state path gains are added to, ratePath = state path of the per-second rate, capPath = optional state path of the resource cap. Add a producer whenever a new per-second resource system lands (herbs, sect income, ...) — no code changes required.

meditation.comment: MeditationSystem tuning (Phase 2 — First Gameplay). baseQiPerSecond is the qi produced per second of active meditation before future multipliers (spirit root, realm, technique, ...). Placeholder balancing.

qi.comment: QiSystem tuning (Phase 2 — First Gameplay). baseMaxQi is the qi cap (derived tuning; future realm/root multipliers stack in _computeQiMax). sources declares every per-second qi income source: ratePath is the state path of that source's current rate contribution (owned by the source's own system, e.g. MeditationSystem writes cultivation.qiSources.meditation). Add a source whenever a new qi-producing system lands — no code changes required.

resources.comment: ResourceSystem tuning (Phase 2 — First Gameplay). items declares every wallet resource the system manages: id maps to state.resources.<id>, label is the display name, capPath is an optional dot path into state of that resource's cap (absent = uncapped). Add a resource by adding one entry here plus a matching key in GameState.resources — no code changes required.

notifications.comment: NotificationManager tuning (Phase 2 — First Gameplay). maxQueueSize bounds the in-memory FIFO queue (oldest drops first). types lists every valid notification type id; the Activity Log renders each entry with a log__item--<type> class. Add a type by adding an id here — no code changes required.

futureSystems.comment: Add per-system tuning blocks below as systems are implemented.
